package.name: g1_isaac_slam
package.description: Isaac ROS cuVSLAM + nvblox (RGBD mode, GPU) + PeopleSemSegNet human segmentation for the Unitree G1, run in a Docker container alongside the native plain_slam_ros2 CPU SLAM for direct comparison. Publishes to isolated vslam_odom/vslam_map frames so both stacks can run at once.
